mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku (sku_id, product_id, stock_quantity, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{productId}, #{stockQuantity}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.product_id AS productId, s.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, s.created_at AS createdAt,
bp.basePrice AS basePrice,
COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(po.option_name, ':', pov.option_value) ORDER BY po.option_name SEPARATOR ', '), '' ) AS optionSummary FROM sku s LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ovs.sku_id = s.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, MAX(price) AS basePrice FROM sku_price WHERE min_qty = 1 AND max_qty IS NULL GROUP BY sku_id ) bp ON bp.sku_id = s.sku_id
WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.stock_quantity, s.created_at, bp.basePrice ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT pov.option_value_id AS optionId, po.product_id AS productId, po.option_name AS optionName, pov.option_value AS optionValue FROM option_value_sku ovs JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id WHERE ovs.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY po.option_name, pov.sort_order, pov.option_value
